unit: Unit 12: Everyday Life with Your Computer
title: Downloading and opening a PDF
drDigitalIntro:
A PDF is a document that looks the same everywhere — same layout on any computer, phone or printer.
• Downloading one puts a copy on your computer. It does not open by itself.
• Downloads collect in one place in the browser, and that is where you open them from.
• A PDF opens in a viewer with page numbers and a zoom control, not in an editor. You read it; you do not usually change it.
• Download the recipe below and open it.

playgroundTask.goal: You downloaded a PDF and opened it

steps.say: Type recipebox.example into the address bar and press Enter.
Open the Downloads panel to find what you just saved.
Zoom in on the recipe so it is easier to read.

drDigitalSuccess: Downloaded, found, opened and enlarged. That is the whole life of a PDF.
drDigitalHint: The download button is on the page. Once it is saved, the Downloads button in the browser's gray row is where you open it from.
